question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "**advance**".
solution:
The correct answer is: **Retreat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"advance"** means to move forward, make progress, or promote something. (आगे बढ़ना, उन्नति करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The army planned to advance into enemy territory during the night.
 
 
• **"Retreat"** refers to moving back or withdrawing from a position or situation, often due to unfavorable conditions. It is the opposite of "advance." (पीछे हटना)
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were forced to retreat after encountering unexpected resistance.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'advance'** is **'retreat'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Retreat**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Progress** (प्रगति): Refers to moving forward or developing in a positive direction.
 
 
• **Example:** The team made significant progress in their research this year.
 
 
 
• **Promote** (प्रचार करना): To support, encourage, or advance the growth or development of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The new campaign is designed to promote healthy eating habits.
 
 
 
• **Proceed** (आगे बढ़ना): To continue or move forward with an action or process.
 
 
• **Example:** After receiving approval, the team proceeded with the project.
